sources.title: GitHub - aedriansagap/vit-eurosat
sources.snippet: 🛰️ Satellite Land Cover Classifier (EuroSAT + Vision Transformer) This repository contains an end-to-end pipeline for training a state-of-the-art Vision Transformer (ViT) model on satellite images to perform Land Use and Land Cover (LULC) Classification.

sources.title: Vision Transformer Eurosat - GitHub
sources.snippet: A state-of-the-art satellite image classification app leveraging a Vision Transformer (ViT) model fine-tuned on the EuroSAT dataset. This Streamlit-based web app enables fast and accurate land use categorization for satellite and aerial images.

sources.snippet: EuroSAT Landcover Classification using CLIP CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining) is a neural network model developed by OpenAI that can understand and generate text from images and vice versa.
